Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) and Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical)

content_sections.heading: DSIIDC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Last date for submission of applications: 5th August 2026 The official notification does not mention a separate notification release date or an application start date beyond the closing date given above.

content_sections.heading: DSIIDC Assistant Executive Engineer Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: DSIIDC is inviting applications from eligible, willing candidates among the non-recommended candidates of the Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2024 conducted by UPSC, whose names and details are available on the UPSC Pratibha Setu Portal (142 candidates from the Civil Engineering stream and 38 candidates from the Electrical Engineering stream). The category-wise vacancy breakup is as follows:

content_sections.heading: DSIIDC Assistant Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be from amongst the list of non-recommended, willing candidates of the Engineering Services Examination-2024 conducted by UPSC (142 candidates of the Civil Engineering stream and 38 candidates of the Electrical Engineering stream), whose names and other details appear on the UPSC Pratibha Setu Portal. This recruitment is not open to the general public through a fresh application process; it is restricted to candidates already listed on the UPSC Pratibha Setu Portal for ESE-2024.

content_sections.heading: DSIIDC Assistant Executive Engineer Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: A degree in Engineering in the relevant discipline (Civil for Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil), Electrical for Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical)) from a recognized University or Institution. The notification does not specify a minimum percentage of marks or additional professional certification requirements.

content_sections.heading: DSIIDC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 21 to 30 years of age as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/Ex-servicemen, etc.) as per Government of India / GNCTD rules.

content_sections.heading: DSIIDC Assistant Executive Engineer 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Pay Level of the post: Level-10 (56100-177500) as per the applicable pay matrix. Pay and allowances shall be as admissible to the employees of DSIIDC.

content_sections.heading: Nature of Appointment
content_sections.text: The appointment shall be made on probation for a period of two (02) years. On satisfactory completion of the probation period, the services shall be confirmed as per the applicable norms of DSIIDC / Government of NCT of Delhi. During the probation period, services may be terminated as per applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: DSIIDC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection shall be based on merit drawn from the Engineering Services Examination-2024, as per the records available on the UPSC Pratibha Setu Portal. No separate written exam or interview by DSIIDC is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for DSIIDC Assistant Executive Engineer Recruitment
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format only. Self-attested copies of relevant documents. Valid category certificates, wherever applicable (OBC/Delhi, SC, EWS, etc.).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DSIIDC Assistant Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may apply only in the prescribed application format. Applications, complete in all respects along with self-attested copies of relevant documents, must be submitted through physical mode at: Chief Manager (Personnel), DSIIDC Ltd., N-36, Bombay Life Building, Connaught Circus, New Delhi-110001. DSIIDC has stated that an email along with the prescribed application form has been sent to the registered email ID of eligible candidates, as available on the UPSC Pratibha Setu Portal. There is no online application/apply-online link mentioned in this notification; submission is only through physical/offline mode.

content_sections.heading: DSIIDC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates preparing for similar opportunities can also explore other Delhi Government Jobs and Engineering Government Jobs across India. Those who cleared the UPSC Engineering Services Examination can check more Engineering Services Jobs and Civil Engineer Government Jobs. Candidates from an Electrical Engineering background can also browse the latest Electrical Engineer Government Jobs matching their qualification.
